label: Reading the meditator’s present doubting
summary: The pinned Adam–Tannery scan, Latin Wikisource transcription and Haldane–Ross translation agree in Meditation II §8’s classification of doubting under thinking and §9’s application to the meditator’s present doubt. The example involves an exercised, first-person doubt even under the dream or deceiver suppositions.
blocker: Apply the example to the same performance of doubting whether thought occurs. A universal result needs an occurring Realizes witness for each act in the selected domain, whose definition must exclude a merely unexercised disposition.
